title: Build bounded residual evidence tasks
objective: Models receive only the specific evidence needed for a named unresolved field.
outcome: A missing publisher document is not converted into a request to guess the contents. A multi-page table does not lose its denominator/header; overlapping chunks cannot double-count a field. Every accepted task has source bytes and a stable ID; incomplete context allows abstention rather than forced completion. No task processes the entire corpus by default. Models are never asked to authorize access or establish endpoint availability.

commits.subject: Classify residual task types
commits.instructions: Separate prose definition, table extraction, scientific ambiguity, missing evidence and access blockade. Only the first two are routine model extraction; scientific ambiguity is an adjudication proposal.
commits.verification: A missing publisher document is not converted into a request to guess the contents.

commits.subject: Chunk with evidence boundaries
commits.instructions: Build token-bounded passages preserving table headers, page positions, field context and overlap identity. Attach exact source/release and expected output scope.
commits.verification: A multi-page table does not lose its denominator/header; overlapping chunks cannot double-count a field.

commits.subject: Emit task manifests and abstention paths
commits.instructions: Record required evidence coverage, token estimate and what cannot be concluded. Send oversized or low-information cases back to parsing/collection.
commits.verification: Every accepted task has source bytes and a stable ID; incomplete context allows abstention rather than forced completion.
